extraction.Name: Ruth Josephine Smith Point At Him
extraction.Refused/Protested: No I did not say anything it was a shock to me as I did not ask for it.
extraction.Buyer: William Tackett, through Bordeaux (Wm. Bordeaux); sale price was $3200, of which $2400 was received in cash; remaining $800 was never paid
extraction.NOTES: Patent delivered at the Rosebud Office. Allottee did not apply for patent. Sale conducted through Wm. Bordeaux; $800 balance was to be held at Farmers State Bank at Kilgore but banker stated he knew nothing of it; Bordeaux repeatedly deferred payment and allottee never received the $800. Allottee states she is not satisfied with the sale. Has had two operations and is not very well. Has one child. Notary: Jas. W. Gross, commission expires 4-28-32. Document sworn April 8, 1929.
